subject: Event planning
body:
Halloween Bash committee — jobs rather than suggestions

HB is the calendar shorthand for Halloween Bash. On public notices, spell it out at least once; Amira has already been asked what the initials mean.

Supplies: check the reusable box before Sara orders tape. Food: collect actual dietary requirements instead of the mysterious category normal food. Layout: keep decorations away from door glass and routes through the rooms.

We have plenty of volunteers for cutting and hanging. We still need clear-away cover. Assign that now, before another class makes more paper bats. Nora holds the headcount; reception should not maintain a competing booking list. Zoe
title: Event planning
